text: China Sports Industry Group (SSE 600158) is controlled by the General Administration of Sport of China (国家体育总局), which is listed as its actual controller; the Administration's Sports Fund Management Centre holds 19.49% (2026-06-30).
short: China Sports Industry Group is controlled by China's sport ministry

source.name: East Money F10 — ShareholderResearch SH600158 (actual controller: 国家体育总局)

additionalSources.name: Chinese Wikipedia — 中体产业集团 (SSE 600158), company under 国家体育总局
additionalSources.quote: 中體產業集團股份有限公司（上交所：600158）是國家體育總局旗下的公司，公司的主要業務為發展中國體育產業和體育主題地產開發。
